title: Standard Balanced 2-Server Queue
description: Standard multi-server scenario with s=2 parallel counters handling moderate arrival flow.
notes: Utilization ρ = 75%. P₀ = 1/7 (14.29%). Erlang C wait probability = 9/14 (64.29%). Expected queue length Lq = 1.93 customers. Little's Laws fully satisfied.

title: High-Efficiency 3-Server Service Center
description: Multi-server facility with s=3 servers operating at 66.7% capacity load.
notes: Utilization ρ = 66.67%. P₀ = 1/9 (11.11%). Probability customer has to wait = 4/9 (44.44%). Average wait in queue is 0.222 hours (13.3 mins).

title: Single-Server Equivalence Check (s=1)
description: Baseline verification proving M/M/s reduces precisely to classic M/M/1 when s=1.
notes: Exact convergence with Model I M/M/1. Server busy 50% of the time, Lq = 0.5, Wq = 0.25 hours (15 mins).

title: 5-Server High-Volume Enterprise Pool
description: Large parallel server pool handling 16 arrivals/hr across 5 servers.
notes: Utilization ρ = 80%. P(wait) = 55.41%. Even under high load, 5 servers keep queue wait under 8.3 minutes (0.1385 hrs).

title: Critical Boundary Condition (λ = s·μ)
description: Edge case where arrival rate matches total server pool capacity (s·μ = 4.0), yielding ρ = 1.00.

expected.warning: Critical Boundary Condition (λ = s·μ): Utilization ρ = 1.00. Stochastic fluctuations prevent the queue from reaching equilibrium. Backlog grows without bound.

notes: System is null-recurrent. Infinite queue variance makes steady state impossible.

title: Severe Overload Multi-Server Surge (λ > s·μ)
description: Incoming arrival rate strictly exceeds combined server capacity (20 > 16), creating runaway queues.

expected.warning: Severe Overload Warning (λ > s·μ, ρ = 1.2500): Arrival rate exceeds total server pool processing capacity. Backlog explodes infinitely (Lq → ∞, Wq → ∞).

notes: System is transient. Definite backlog accumulation without stationary limits.

title: Invalid Negative Arrival Rate
description: Negative arrival rate input triggering robust error rejection.

expected.error: Arrival rate (λ) must be strictly greater than zero (> 0).

notes: Sanitization blocks execution before mathematical computation.

title: Invalid Server Count (s = 0)
description: Zero server count rejected by input validation rules.

expected.error: Number of servers (s) must be a positive integer (s ≥ 1).

notes: Queuing models require at least one functional service station.
